_comment: Generated by frontend/src/tests/mediaCryptoKat.test.ts with WRITE_KAT=1. Cross-language contract for the media frame AEAD: asserted by vitest AND by tests/media_aead_kat.rs. Do not hand-edit.

vectors.name: video-key-10-byte-header
vectors.note: Ordinary keyframe. Header (10B) is AAD, body is encrypted.

vectors.name: video-delta-3-byte-header
vectors.note: Ordinary delta frame. Header is 3 bytes, not 10.

vectors.name: audio-1-byte-header
vectors.note: Audio frames carry no `type`; clear header is 1 byte.

vectors.name: video-key-frame-SHORTER-than-its-header
vectors.note: EDGE CASE. A 4-byte keyframe is shorter than the 10-byte clear header. encryptFrame does Math.min(headerLen, data.length), so n=4 and the body is EMPTY — output is header + bare 16-byte GCM tag + iv + magic. A Rust port that slices [10..] here would panic or produce garbage.

vectors.name: audio-header-only-empty-body
vectors.note: EDGE CASE. 1-byte audio frame: n=1, body empty, ciphertext is the tag alone.

vectors.name: video-delta-exactly-header-length
vectors.note: EDGE CASE. Body boundary lands exactly at the header length.
